purpose: Synthetic formula/parameter/radius coverage, not accuracy of chemical solvation predictions
geometry: Four identical-element atoms at (a,a,a),(-a,-a,a),(-a,a,-a),(a,-a,-a), a=1.5R/(2sqrt(2)); all pair distances 1.5R. Each atom has either +0.37e or -0.37e. Coordinates rounded to 8 decimal angstroms; same input supplied to both implementations.
fallback_reason: Author executable crashes in GEPOL for tested isolated atom, separated two-atom, and separated four-atom inputs; overlapping tetrahedral atomic spheres run successfully. This is a numerical fixture choice and not a chemical-accuracy assertion.
reference: author uESE v1.2 July 2025, energy output rounded to 0.01 kcal/mol
release_note: The final source additionally protects input paths from CSV overwrite; all 76 reference cases were replayed successfully by tests/run_tests.py in the final 994-assertion run.
